subject: PARADOx Study - Participant cannot enroll in study!
body:
Hi Amin/Mohammed,

Apologies for contacting you in the weekend. I was checking whether all the studyID’s for our study (ID 4050 – Tienertips) were in order. It turns out one participant was not yet registered. I have been in contact with them, but they cannot enroll in the study via the Avicenna app. They are able to install the app, fill in the registration code for the study, but clicking the join study button doesn’t work, so they are stuck on this screen.

Re-installing and relaunching the app does not seem to work. Do you have any advice for us? Could this participant (ID 101409) be enrolled in the study from your end? The participant is using an iPhone if this is relevant.

Best regards,

Rick van Logchem

subject: PARADOx Study - Participant cannot enroll in study!
body:
Hi Rick

This is Amin (Amin from the product team). I have some guesses here. It would be great if you could answer the following questions:

1- Is your study open to public or participants require an invitation to join the study?

2- If your study requires invitation, have you double checked the email address that you have entered to invite them and the email address that your participant used to sign up? At times missing a "dot" in the email address (e.g my.email@example.com instead of myemail@example.com) results in such errors. Note that dots in the email addresses are ignored, so they will still receive the email invitation.

3- If your study requires invitation, have you double checked the enrollment period? At times there's a chance that the participant might be trying to join the study after the enrollment period is over.

Please check these items and let me know if they resolved your issue.
Best regards,
Amin

subject: Re: PARADOx Study - Participant cannot enroll in study!
body:
Hi Amin,

Thanks for your quick reply! Very much appreciate the help, especially in the weekend. To answer your questions:
1. The study is open to the public (we provide participants with the registration code, after which they enroll themselves through the app)
2. NA as the study only requires the registration code to enroll.
3. The study start time is set on monday oct 21st. As far as I am aware we haven't set a specific closing date. I just tested this quickly by enrolling myself in the study on my phone, which worked perfectly.

The app itself seems to work for this participant. They have made an Avicenna account (ID 101409) and can navigate the app. They tried to register for our study by filling in the registration code, but it seems they get stuck at trying to accept the consent materials as nothing happens when they click the join / accept button.

Best regards,
Rick
